_scale_note: Design decision, not a canon figure. Chamber of Secrets gives 'fifty feet', which no source converts to Minecraft blocks. The rig is 8.5 blocks nose to tail at scale 1.0 and 1.4 blocks tall; 1.4 takes it to roughly 12 blocks long, which reads enormous beside a player without making the square hitbox impassable. The real limit is that a vanilla hitbox is square in plan, so no scale can make a 12-block serpent occupy a 12-block-long box - only a multi-part entity could, and that is out of scope here. Scale raises hitbox and reach together via Attributes.SCALE.
